<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column3655_ac2999-5b"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_768bde-ef wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-1-color has-text-color hls-hover_underline" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_768bde-ef">Common Questions</p>



<h2 class="kt-adv-heading3655_93ffff-a1 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_93ffff-a1">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id3655_4b8aaa-06 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top kt-inner-column-height-full">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column3655_f0f496-8d"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-accordion alignnone"><div class="kt-accordion-wrap kt-accordion-id3655_555988-76 kt-accordion-has-4-panes kt-active-pane-0 kt-accordion-block kt-pane-header-alignment-left kt-accodion-icon-style-basic kt-accodion-icon-side-right" style="max-width:none"><div class="kt-accordion-inner-wrap" data-allow-multiple-open="false" data-start-open="none">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-1 kt-pane3655_34d08d-6a"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">What does HOA management actually include?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_d29a33-ad wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_d29a33-ad">HOA management supports the day-to-day operations of a community, from financial management and assessment collection to vendor coordination, maintenance support, resident communication, and board meeting preparation. With RealManage, boards gain a trusted partner that helps ease administrative burden, streamline operations, and create a better experience for residents.</p>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-2 kt-pane3655_aab526-47"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">How does switching to RealManage work?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_c3418d-c6 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_c3418d-c6">RealManage follows a structured onboarding process designed to make the transition smooth, organized, and predictable. Our team works with the board and previous management company to gather key records, set up systems and owner data, configure board and homeowner communications, coordinate vendor and banking details, and begin financial reporting. The average onboarding period is about 90 days, with dedicated support across operations, accounting, compliance, and owner communications to help the community start with clarity and confidence.</p>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-3 kt-pane3655_c5c321-e6"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">Do residents get access to online tools?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_e31ef3-c5 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_e31ef3-c5">Yes. RealManage’s purpose-built technology, CiraNet, includes dedicated portals for both board members and residents. Residents can make payments, submit requests, access community documents, and stay connected with their association, while board members have 24/7 access to financial information, reports, community records, and other important board resources. <a href="https://realmanage.com/services/technology-solutions/">Learn more</a>.</p>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-4 kt-pane3655_a38997-0c"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">How does RealManage handle resident requests and concerns?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_3a99d1-5a wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_3a99d1-5a">RealManage gives residents convenient ways to get help with association-related questions, payments, account information, documents, violations, amenity requests, and other community needs. Residents can use the CiraNet Owner/Resident Portal 24/7 to manage many common tasks, or contact the Resident Support Group for assistance during business hours. </p>
</div></div></div>
</div></div></div>
</div></div>



<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column3655_234149-61"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-accordion alignnone"><div class="kt-accordion-wrap kt-accordion-id3655_c9abd0-fb kt-accordion-has-4-panes kt-active-pane-0 kt-accordion-block kt-pane-header-alignment-left kt-accodion-icon-style-basic kt-accodion-icon-side-right" style="max-width:none"><div class="kt-accordion-inner-wrap" data-allow-multiple-open="false" data-start-open="none">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-1 kt-pane3655_ef7477-73"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">How are HOA dues calculated?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_a2a36c-f5 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_a2a36c-f5">HOA dues are typically calculated based on the community’s annual budget. The board reviews expected expenses such as landscaping, maintenance, insurance, utilities, reserve contributions, management services, and other operating costs. Those expenses are then allocated among homeowners according to the community’s governing documents.</p>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-3 kt-pane3655_d79d33-cb"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">Does RealManage handle collections?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_73885d-cb wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_73885d-cb">Yes. RealManage supports assessment billing and collections, including payment processing, delinquency reporting, reminder notices, and coordination with legal counsel when needed.</p>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-4 kt-pane3655_7c223c-3b"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">What makes RealManage different from other companies?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_51e7ea-a4 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_51e7ea-a4">RealManage offers boards the benefit of responsive local support backed by the resources and expertise of a national organization. Our teams understand the unique needs of the communities they serve, while providing the technology, financial oversight, operational support, and industry experience boards need to lead effectively. By helping reduce administrative burden and improve transparency, RealManage enables boards to focus on building well-managed communities and delivering a positive experience for residents.</p>
</div></div></div>



<div class="wp-block-kadence-pane kt-accordion-pane kt-accordion-pane-2 kt-pane3655_1ffc11-9d"><div class="kt-accordion-header-wrap"><button class="kt-blocks-accordion-header kt-acccordion-button-label-show" type="button"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title-wrap"><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-title">What is the difference between the HOA board and the management company?</span></span><span class="kt-blocks-accordion-icon-trigger"></span></button></div><div class="kt-accordion-panel kt-accordion-panel-hidden"><div class="kt-accordion-panel-inner">
<p class="kt-adv-heading3655_1f6284-24 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading3655_1f6284-24">The HOA board is the decision-making body for the association. Board members approve budgets, set policies, make community decisions, and are ultimately responsible for the direction of the community. RealManage does not replace the board or make decisions on its behalf. Instead, we help carry out the board’s decisions by managing day-to-day operations, coordinating vendors, supporting financial and administrative tasks, communicating with residents, and providing professional guidance.</p>
</div></div></div>
</div></div></div>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>
